name: Sling / Safety / Self-Locking Hook
desc: Forged alloy-steel lifting hooks in eye and clevis forms, spanning the ABLE and Green Pin ranges. ABLE self-locking safety hooks (Model HSE eye / HSC clevis) close automatically under load and cannot disengage until the release trigger is pressed; the HSA adds a swivel to take out sling-leg twist. ABLE sling hooks (HES eye / HCS clevis) give a large throat with a stainless safety-latch spring, and grab hooks (HGC/HGE) shorten and choke chain. Green Pin® Sling Hook E / CL to EN 1677-2 grade 8 (WLL 1.12–32.8 t) and grade-10 grab hooks complete the range. Grade 80/100 alloy steel, quenched and tempered; ultimate load 4× WLL, proof-tested to 2.5× WLL and fatigue-rated to 1.5× WLL at 20,000 cycles, individually batch-marked with size, CE and G80/T8.
